name: Necklace Recovery
summary: Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar seeks a valuable necklace from the Uldaman dig site. It may be damaged, but he wants it brought back.

sections.title: A Search in Uldaman
sections.body: At the dig site in Uldaman, you search for the necklace Dran Droffers wants returned to Orgrimmar. Its value matters to him, though it may be damaged when you find it.

faq.answer: Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar wants the necklace brought back to him.

faq.q: Where should I look for the necklace?
faq.answer: The necklace is sought within the Uldaman dig site.

faq.q: Does the necklace need to be undamaged?

faq.answer: The text identifies it as valuable, but gives no reason beyond that.
